verdict: r7 is a real step up from r5. The narration is gone: no "Midday heat... 6 good moves open right now", no Wall subtitle, no footer. Notes are one line, stickers say a word instead of showing clip art, and the tabs have icons. The psst shuffle, the card stack, the trip ticket and the Tonight flyers put value on the first screen, the neon night clock and moon slider are great, and Stay exists. It finally feels like a toy, not a list. It is not ready to go in front of the friend yet, for five reasons. (1) On every Today screen the card peeking under the deck shows its title cut in half, and some stickers sit on top of the note text (TIKI covers "anything"). (2) Events opens on two Oct 2 flyers, with "Save Save Save" under each, above a field of empty mint. r5 opened on "Your stay" with John Summit; this is a regression for the exact test case. (3) The Secret mood, which is the hook, is off-screen at 390px and at 1440px. (4) The share loop is broken: the copied plan has no link, and the box for a friend's code is buried under 60 ghost stickers. (5) On desktop, which is Sami's own view, clicking a Stay pin does nothing, the Trip map is a dotted line with no stops, pins clip at the top and pile on each other, and Where shows a flat purple void on the left. Stay looks good but tells you almost nothing. Each fob repeats the hotel name and a "$" sign. Price, neighborhood, the move, and how far it is from Kaseya (the friend's one real question) all sit behind a tap the screenshot harness never captured. Pill chips are also back on Events, Trip and Stay even though DECISIONS lists them as rejected. The fixes come to about half a day. Score: 6.5, against the r2 baseline of 6.0.

Flyer tabs: reuse the Stub's seeded jagged clip-path and ghost-fly so tapping a tab rips it off and flies it to the Trip icon, like Keep does to Kept.
Friend code arrival (?code=): break the seal with the conic hold animation automatically, then slap a "from a friend" stamp using the existing slap keyframe.
Trip ticket on Today: add a countdown ("49 days to John Summit", then "Doors in 3h" on the day) instead of the static shows and stops counts.
After psst deals, slap the sticker onto the card (scale 1.7 to 1, the existing slap keyframe) with a 10ms vibrate, so the deal lands.
